# Posture AI System
Intelligent ergonomics and real-time biometric posture monitoring system.
Operates on desktop computers using computer vision (MediaPipe Pose) to assess seating posture, forward head tilt, shoulder symmetry, and sedentary duration.
Features haptic feedback integration via ESP32 wearable watch and browser audio alerts.
Authentication is secured with Bcrypt, HttpOnly JWT cookies, and Resend email OTP verification.
